description: This file implements authentication endpoints for a FastAPI-based backend, including user registration, login, profile retrieval, profile update, and token refresh. It uses JWT for token management and interacts with a user repository and database schema conversions.

methods.name: register_user(user_data: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Registers a new user, hashes their password, saves to the database, and returns an access token and user info.

methods.name: login_user(login_data: UserLogin, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returning an access token and user info if successful.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate, current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile details of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Generates a new access token for the authenticated user.
